content.json:
## 🔐 Nimbus.BitLockerGroupSync — Runbook monitoring

Attività del runbook **Sync-BitLockerComplianceGroups**: trend dei job, errori e riepiloghi. Il filtro temporale si applica a tutti i pannelli.

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.AUTOMATION" and Category == "JobStreams"
| where RunbookName_s == "__RUNBOOK_NAME__"
| where ResultDescription contains "[MEMBERSHIP_CYCLE]"
| extend Payload = parse_json(extract(@"(\{.*\})", 1, ResultDescription))
| project OraCiclo = TimeGenerated, Aggiunte = toint(Payload.added), Rimozioni = toint(Payload.removed), JobId = JobId_g
| order by OraCiclo asc
| render timechart
content.title: 📈 Aggiunte e rimozioni per ciclo

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.AUTOMATION" and Category == "JobLogs"
| where RunbookName_s == "__RUNBOOK_NAME__"
| where ResultType in ("Completed","Failed","Suspended","Started","Stopped")
| project TimeGenerated, ResultType, JobId = JobId_g
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 50
content.title: 🗒️ Ultimi job

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.AUTOMATION" and Category == "JobStreams"
| where RunbookName_s == "__RUNBOOK_NAME__"
| where StreamType_s == "Error" or ResultDescription contains "[ERROR]"
| project TimeGenerated, StreamType_s, ResultDescription
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 50
content.title: 🚨 Errori recenti

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.AUTOMATION" and Category == "JobStreams"
| where RunbookName_s == "__RUNBOOK_NAME__"
| where ResultDescription contains "Riepilogo" or ResultDescription contains "Encrypted:" or ResultDescription contains "KeyMissing"
| project TimeGenerated, ResultDescription
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 30
content.title: 🧾 Righe di riepilogo (verbose)

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.AUTOMATION" and Category == "JobStreams"
| where RunbookName_s == "__RUNBOOK_NAME__"
| where ResultDescription contains "[MEMBERSHIP_ADD]" or ResultDescription contains "[MEMBERSHIP_REMOVE]"
| extend Payload = parse_json(extract(@"(\{.*\})", 1, ResultDescription))
| extend RawOperation = tostring(Payload["operation"])
| extend Operazione = case(RawOperation == "Add", "Aggiunta", RawOperation == "Remove", "Rimozione", ResultDescription contains "[MEMBERSHIP_ADD]", "Aggiunta", ResultDescription contains "[MEMBERSHIP_REMOVE]", "Rimozione", RawOperation), Gruppo = tostring(Payload.groupName), Device = tostring(Payload.deviceName), ObjectId = tostring(Payload.objectId)
| where isnotempty(Device)
| project TimeGenerated, Operazione, Gruppo, Device, ObjectId, JobId = JobId_g
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 500
content.title: 🔄 Device aggiunti e rimossi dai gruppi
